# netactuate_tag_assignment (Resource)

Manages a Tag Assignment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_tag_assignment" "example" {
  identifier    = "12345"
  resource_name = "virtual_server"
  tag_id        = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (Number) Resource identifier to tag
- `resource_name` (String) Resource type name accepted by the tag API
- `tag_id` (Number) Tag ID to assign

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_tag_assignment.example 12345
```
